subject: POC amendment: mid‑course extension vs. credit voucher
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@clearbridge.health>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@clearbridge.health
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — brief ask re: extension

Hi Jonas —

Quick update from our side: ingestion work has slipped by ~2 weeks because we found a schema mismatch in our ETL. The team expects to need an extra 3 calendar weeks to get us to reliable daily traffic so the evaluation metrics are meaningful.

We’d prefer to avoid increasing headcount for this; two options sound workable for us: a straight 3‑week extension to the time‑boxed pilot, or a credit voucher (token bucket) we can burn once the ingestion is ready. Can you outline cost/discount tradeoffs for both? Also need a simple amendment we can push quickly to procurement if we agree.

We’ve attached the current SOW for reference.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Li | Head of AI | ClearBridge Health
Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 220 KB)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Emma Li <emma@clearbridge.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — brief ask re: extension

On Thu, Jul 10, 2025 at 09:12 AM Emma Li <emma@clearbridge.health> wrote:
> Quick update from our side: ingestion work has slipped by ~2 weeks...

Hi Emma — appreciate the heads up and the attachment. We can do either approach; here are two concrete options so procurement has something to review quickly:

Option A — Time extension (3 weeks):
- Add 3 calendar weeks to current pilot term.
- No change to included token allotment; additional usage billed at standard trial overage rate.
- We can offer a one‑time 15% credit on incremental overage tokens for the extension period (applies only to tokens beyond the original pilot cap).

Option B — Credit voucher (token bucket):
- Issue a fixed voucher equivalent to ~$12k of token credit (approximate to 3 weeks expected usage at your traffic profile).
- Voucher applies to calls to the same model(s) used in the pilot, valid for 90 days.
- No changes to contract term.

Operational notes:
- If you need billing to be confined to the pilot SOW (no new PO), Option A is faster to accept — we will send an amendment that just extends dates.
- If procurement needs a discrete spend line/item for forecasting, Option B gives a clean invoice/Voucher line item.

I’ve attached a draft amendment (pilot‑amendment‑draft.docx) for Option A and a quick pricing sheet for Option B. If you want, we can apply a slightly higher credit in Option B (we can stretch to $14k) if you commit to a short follow‑on pilot/rollover conversation before voucher expiry.

Next steps: which option do you want us to draft for procurement?

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555‑0187
Attachments: pilot-amendment-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 45 KB)

Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — brief ask re: extension

Jonas —

15% ceiling on overage credit for a short extension is fine from a discount perspective. If we move to a voucher, limit to $14k and mark as non‑refundable. Finance should confirm whether we can pre‑invoice the voucher or need to invoice upon draw.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — brief ask re: extension

Quick ops note — finance runbook below: we can do either but prefer voucher invoiced up front and recognized over the 90‑day period. If they want extension only, we will:
- Apply 15% credit on incremental overages during the extension,
- Invoice any estimated overage at end of extension period (standard net30).

For the voucher path, pricing sheet attached with a line item for the $12k/$14k buckets and suggested GL codes. Recommend pushing the $14k voucher if they commit to 1x technical review checkpoint within 30 days (helps us to convert).

Ben
Ben Carter | Sales Finance | Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing-sheet.csv (text/csv, 3 KB)

Thanks — that helps. Procurement prefers a voucher line (cleaner for our forecast) and ClearBridge can approve up to $13.5k if Redwood can split the difference.

Request: please send the voucher invoice (we’ll route for internal approval) and a one‑page amendment noting voucher terms (90‑day validity, applies to pilot models, non‑refundable). Procurement: please expect a DocuSign link for the invoice/amendment.

Jonas — if you can get that over by EOD tomorrow we’ll start approvals.

Best,
Emma
